comment: Type-check config for the pure-TS bridge core (src/bridge) + its Node tests. The Expo app build uses Expo's own tsconfig (added when the app is scaffolded); the core src itself uses only web-standard APIs (fetch, TextEncoder) so it runs unchanged in React Native.
comment2: Scoped to the pure-TS core; the RN layer (App.tsx, src/rnSocket.ts) is type-checked by the Expo toolchain once the app is scaffolded, since it needs react-native types.
